caption: A ball is thrown across a sunlit yard, and the ball's shadow slides along the ground beneath it and meets the ball where it lands.

sa.check: A ball is thrown across a sunlit yard.
The ball's shadow slides along the ground beneath it.
The shadow meets the ball where it lands.
The throw comes first and the shadow tracks the flight.

pc.expect: The shadow tracks the ball's path on the ground, separating from it while it is high and rejoining at the landing spot.
pc.fail: It lags or vanishes in flight; or stays attached to the ball in mid-air; or fails to meet it at landing.

pc.expect: The ball follows one smooth arc.
pc.fail: It flies flat; or hangs; or changes direction in mid-air.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the ball's round outline.
pc.fail: It becomes a different shape; or splits; or becomes a long streak.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the side away from the sun.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or switches sides during the flight; or it is missing in sunlight.
A second ball or shadow appears; or the ball vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid.

pc.expect: The ball's colour and the yard stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the yard changes.
